title: elymus corsicus
intro: Elymus corsicus, commonly known as Corsican wheat grass, is a perennial grass species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Elymus corsicus include its potential to reduce symptoms of anxiety and depression, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against certain bacteria and fungi. The bioactive constituents present in Elymus corsicus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other organic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
